_comment: OpenSpec register fragment — logic-shared-flows-and-automations task T05 (REQ-BQSF-004). Adds the `run-automation` action kind and its one key, declared BEFORE anything writes them. The merge concatenates the `type` enum list with this one entry and adds the `automation` property to the action items. A run-automation step names a shared automation, or one of the same app, by uuid; the compiler runs that automation's compiled flow as an `openregister.sub-flow` step that waits for its result (design.md D4).

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Ordered typed action records. Only combinations allowed by the v1 compilation matrix (design.md Decision 2) may be saved: unsupported combinations are blocked fail-closed in the editor and at compile time.

type.title: Action Type
type.description: `approval` (automation-approval-steps) is selectable only on object-created|object-updated|object-deleted|lifecycle-transition triggers: compiles to an OpenRegister ApprovalChain; blocked fail-closed on schedule/manual. `generateDocument` (automation-document-action) is selectable on the same four event/lifecycle-transition triggers. Dispatches an owner-impersonated call to Docudesk's pinned `correspondence/generate` route; blocked fail-closed on schedule/manual.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: run-automation (logic-shared-flows-and-automations): the uuid of the automation this step runs, a shared automation or one of the same app. Its compiled flow runs as a step and the later steps see its output items. An automation cannot run itself.
